There is no usable implied move: the front chain's ATM spread is 117% of mid and open interest is 300 (baseline). Its own day-1 reactions to the last four bmo prints, close to close from Yahoo daily bars: Nov-20-2025 -8.1%, Feb-11-2026 -3.6%, May-21-2026 -6.9%, Aug-20-2026 +1.3%. That is one up in four, about 5.5% median size, and in May and Aug a large day-2 move came after. Run-in: +2.0% over 20 sessions and -2.7% over 5, against KWEB -8.1%/-7.8% and EDU -10.3% over 20. The stock is +100% over the year and 8.8% below its 52-week high. It went from about 14.5 in late September to about 19.5 by mid-October, on the AI-agent story (LobsterAI 2.0 in September, a migration push for Tencent QClaw users around Oct 10), not on its own numbers. Consensus (Yahoo, 2026-11-18): revenue RMB1.653bn (range 1.631-1.676bn, +1.5% y/y on Q3-25's RMB1,628.5m); EPS RMB0.22 per ADS from ONE analyst, which looks stale against Q2's RMB0.61 actual. There is no formal guide. On the Q2 call (2026-08-20) management promised 'meaningful breakthroughs at the operating profit level in H2 2026', further y/y gross-margin gains in online marketing in Q3, and device margins back above 40% in H2. Short interest is 0.62m shares, 2.7% of float, 20 days to cover (Oct-30 settlement). Orbis holds 19.7% of the ADS (13G/A filed 2026-11-16, as of 09-30, down slightly from 20.1%). Insiders filed Form 144/Form 4 sales in late Aug and early Sep.
view: This print will probably have the same shape as Q2: a lower revenue line, with a profit line that looks much better against a very easy base. My own arithmetic on revenue: learning services up about 20% on Q3-25's RMB643.1m (in line with Q2's +20.9%) gives about RMB772m. Devices down 30-40% on about RMB246m gives RMB150-172m. Online marketing faces Q3-25's +51% NetEase/overseas comp (RMB739.7m) after Q2 already fell 7.7%; at Q2's level plus last year's seasonal step-up that is about RMB600-700m. The total is RMB1.52-1.64bn, so revenue probably falls y/y and misses the RMB1.653bn consensus by 1-8%; consensus needs marketing roughly flat. Profit is the other side. Q3-25 operating income was only RMB28.3m and net income RMB0.1m. Q2-26 was a record RMB111.5m operating and RMB73.8m net, and management talks of an H2 operating-profit breakthrough. So a large EPS 'beat' against a single 0.22 estimate is close to certain, with headlines like 'ninth straight quarter of operating profit' and an operating profit up several-fold. Q2 had exactly this mix: revenue missed about 6%, EPS beat about 277%, and day 1 was only +1.3%. The record of these prints is mostly sell-the-news on day 1 (three of four down), with the drift coming later. Against that, the stock already fell 6% today on almost no volume, which lowers the bar a little. I cannot see the deciding line (marketing revenue and the size of the operating-profit step) better than the price does. A thin, volatile ADR on a mixed print is close to a coin flip, with a slight lean down from the revenue arithmetic and the day-1 base rate.
unpriced: Possibly the revenue line: one stale analyst model at RMB1.653bn seems to assume online marketing roughly flat against a +51% comp. I cannot show the price holds that, but Q2 showed the stock looks through a revenue miss when profit beats, so this gap is not enough to call a direction.

recommendation.reason: A likely revenue miss and decline (my segment arithmetic against a tough marketing comp) sits beside a near-certain EPS beat against an easy base and one stale estimate. Q2 had the same mix and moved +1.3% on day 1. No dated evidence makes one side of the deciding line (marketing revenue, the size of the operating-profit step) clearly more likely than a thin, already-down-6%-today price assumes.
recommendation.what_would_flip_it: Online marketing back to growth (AI-app and short-drama advertisers more than replacing the NetEase comp) together with Q3 operating income clearly above Q2's RMB111.5m record. That would be a clean beat on both lines and would argue for a move up of 8% or more.

self_critique: The strongest case against a down lean is the profit line. Management promised an H2 operating-profit 'breakthrough', the comp is RMB28.3m, and the only estimate is RMB0.22 against Q2's 0.61, so the headline will be a several-fold profit increase. Orbis-style value holders may also read a revenue fall as deliberate margin discipline, as management framed Q2. Today's 6% drop may already be the sell-the-news, and the day-1 base rate is four observations. The case for a down lean is that the stock doubled on an AI-agent story the quarterly numbers barely touch, and a y/y revenue decline is a new headline. These roughly cancel, which is why I stay close to 50 and do not recommend.
approach_notes: P6 (take the run-in apart; find the line it trades on) and P3's own-arithmetic route paid: the segment rebuild showed the revenue consensus is fragile. P7's push not to stay at 50 just because the line is invisible had little to work with here: the inputs point in opposite directions (revenue down, profit up), so 50 is the honest answer, not a default.
